title: Bioimage Extension (experimental)
description: Describes a bioimage (OME-Zarr) asset: axes, sizes, and ontology terms for specimen and imaging method.

bioimage:source.description: Short id of the resource that published the image, e.g. bia.

bioimage:wells.description: Number of wells in the plate.

bioimage:ncbitaxon.description: Specimen taxon id, flat next to bioimage:organism, for search.

bioimage:fbbi.description: Imaging method id, flat next to bioimage:imaging_method, for search.

bioimage:plate_id.description: On a well, the id of the plate Item it belongs to.

bioimage:well.description: On a well, its position as OME-NGFF writes the path, e.g. A/10.

bioimage:field_count_max.description: Maximum number of fields per well in the plate, as OME-NGFF field_count. Individual wells may hold fewer.

bioimage:level.description: What the Item denotes: one image, a whole HCS plate, or one well of a plate.

ontology_source.description: Ontology the term comes from, e.g. NCBITaxon, FBbi.

term_id.description: CURIE of the term, e.g. NCBITaxon:9606.
